title: malvastrum scabrum
intro: Malvastrum scabrum, commonly known as Hairy Leaf Malva, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Malvastrum scabrum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
